requires: logging: retain integral values in bounded numeric message formats
resolves_prior_deferral: Four memory sites in snapshot-chainstate-lifecycle. Known long fatal paragraph remains plain and deferred.

rules.review_note: Preserve Info, exact old tinyformat text, evaluation order and integer decimal-MB division. Memory stays UINT; no float coercion or invented fractional part. The percentage keeps the original float calculation and consumer .2f precision. Component controls compare actual old/new renderer and UINT64MAX/INT64MIN exactly; native/valid-snapshot producer-path coverage remains separately recorded. No snapshot consensus/cache/coin state changes.
